purpose: Resolve moving source authority without invalidating executions whose declared material inputs are unchanged.

decisions.CURRENT: authority revision and all declared materials are unchanged
decisions.CURRENT_REBOUND: authority revision advanced but all declared root materials remain equivalent; automatic rebind is allowed
decisions.STALE_AFFECTED: one or more declared materials or their transitive dependencies changed
decisions.UNKNOWN_FAIL_CLOSED: dependency graph, revision, material or fingerprint proof is incomplete or invalid

integration.external_digest_rule: DIGEST materials must be hydrated from a governed provider before evaluation
